entries.summary: San Carlos Borromeo Parish Church, commonly called Mahatao Church, is a heritage church on Batan Island. Its actual municipality is Mahatao, distinguishing it from similarly named churches in other countries and Philippine provinces.

This is the church in Mahatao on Batan Island, not the San Carlos Borromeo church in Aguadilla, Puerto Rico.

entries.summary: The National Museum of the Philippines–Batanes occupies a former United States Coast Guard LORAN station in Uyugan. Its reused navigation-station complex provides a cultural-history setting, with current visitor access requiring confirmation after documented repair work.
overview: The National Museum restored the former Long Range Navigation station for adaptive reuse in 2012. The complex’s earlier buildings served equipment, workshop, crew and administrative functions, giving the museum a distinctive built setting. The institution’s published address is Old Loran, Itbud, Uyugan. A 2025 government procurement document records repairs needed after typhoon damage in 2024. That document does not establish the museum’s current opening status, so contact the institution before planning an interior visit.
tips: Confirm current visitor access directly with the museum.
